name: Gym Bod
description: Watches for the moment a gym's booking window opens and secures a place in classes that fill fast. Useful if the instructors you want run early or late sessions that vanish within minutes; it assumes you already know which classes you're after.

official.title: Gym Bod by peter
official.description: Books popular gym classes the moment the booking window opens, so you don't miss a busy instructor's morning and evening slots.
